result.summary: The layout mostly holds up, but several issues stand out: the active bottom-nav tab doesn't match the content shown, restaurant card titles are hard-clipped without ellipsis, favorite-button styling is inconsistent between cards, and card imagery/treatments are inconsistent across the carousel.

issues.description: The bottom navigation highlights 'Profile' as the active tab, but the screen displayed is the Home/discovery feed (address, search, promo banner, restaurant lists).
issues.suggestion: Sync the active tab state with the rendered route so 'Home' is highlighted on this screen.

issues.description: The third card in 'Fastest near you' shows a hard-clipped title ('Trattoria Piccol') and clipped delivery text with no ellipsis, making it look broken rather than intentionally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Apply text truncation with an ellipsis, and add a right-side peek/padding so partially visible carousel cards read as scrollable content.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card (pizza) is cut off by the bottom navigation bar; its name, rating and metadata are not visible and the image is sliced mid-card.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding/safe-area inset equal to the nav bar height on the scroll container so cards can scroll fully into view.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently: white circular background on the ramen card, dark/translucent background on the pizza card.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button on a single background treatment and contrast level across all cards.

issues.description: Image treatment is inconsistent in the 'Fastest near you' row — the first card has a light gray background while the others use dark vignetted photos, making the row look unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Normalize image backgrounds/overlays across cards, or apply the same gradient scrim to every thumbnail.

issues.description: The category chip row is clipped at the right edge with only a sliver of the next chip visible and no fade or arrow affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal padding and a gradient fade or scroll indicator to signal more categories exist.

issues.description: Icon-only controls (notification bell with unread dot, heart favorite buttons) have no visible text labels, and accessible names cannot be inferred visually.
issues.suggestion: Ensure each icon button has an accessible label (e.g. 'Notifications, 1 unread', 'Add Tokumaru Ramen Bar to favorites') and a minimum 44x44pt touch target.
